subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` permanently reject legacy ownerless session rows, leaving their recovery and management to operators or non-plugin clients?
rationale: The implementation correctly closes the cross-plugin boundary, but strict rejection changes the persisted authorization contract for rows created before plugin ownership metadata existed.

options.title: Approve Strict Boundary
options.body: Accept ownerless-row denial, document the operator recovery path, and require deployed plugin-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Add Ownership Migration
options.body: Provide a bounded doctor migration or explicit operator adoption flow before enforcing rejection.

options.title: Pause Both Candidates
options.body: Hold both fixes if maintainers do not accept either strict denial or a migration commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve Strict Boundary
recommendation.body: Accept ownerless-row denial, document the operator recovery path, and require deployed plugin-runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current ownership helper and session projection behavior on main trace directly to Vincent Koc's recent commit.
